results.claim: States as unhedged fact that these Dec 2025 items are non-recurring/one-off.
results.evidence: The one-off characterisation is hedged ("appears to include single-month items; reviewer to confirm"). It is never stated as unhedged fact.

results.claim: Asserts an accounting treatment or a cause for these items as fact (e.g. 'year-end bonus accrual', 'option vesting', 'should be excluded/normalised').
results.evidence: The commentary gives no cause or accounting treatment for SBC or Bonus, and no "accrual", "vesting" or "should be excluded" language. The Income Tax Benefit is described only as the reason the month was positive, and the Bad Debts credit is explicitly left for the reviewer.
